# AnyJobQueue.destroy() method

Closes the broker connection and releases the queue's resources for good. Unlike [AnyJobQueue.stop()](/api/job/latest/job.anyjobqueue.stop/) this is not reversible.

**Signature:**

```typescript
destroy(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;
